summary.text: Erica Schwartz is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has represented House District 18A since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A business owner, she earned an associate degree from South Central College in 2019.

paragraphs.text: Erica Schwartz earned an associate degree from South Central College in 2019.
Her career experience includes working for her husband's family business, Nicollet Mart, and as a student recruiter.
Schwartz took office in the Minnesota House of Representatives on January 14, 2025, succeeding Jeff Brand.
The Republican primary for her seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
